case: a datablock: an object inside a .blend, with no digest of bytes
why: A datablock has no canonical bytes. The stamp says so with the prefix (emstruct1: compares, never proves) and carries no path: the blend:// locator is a private hint. The locator's form is s3Dgraphy's make_blend_locator, pinned here with a space and an accent so the two cannot drift.
